title: Casualties reported after 7.0 quake strikes China's Tibet -- state media

blocks.text: BEIJING, China — A strong 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China’s Tibet region late Thursday and casualties have been reported, state news agency Xinhua said, citing local authorities. The report did not offer any details about the number or type of casualties. The epicenter of the quake, which struck at 10:33 pm (1433 GMT), was located in a mountainous area about 190 kilometers (120 miles) east-northeast of Nagqu, and 390 kilometres northeast of the regional capital Lhasa, the US Geological Survey said.
